title: Refuse code under a claim that reserves no paths, so scope isolation cannot be skipped by claiming without --scope
goal: Both scope checks (scripts/check-task-scope.py in pre-commit, scripts/check-workflow-compliance.sh in pre-push and CI) return success when a claim declares no scopes, so an agent can claim a task with no --scope and write any path: the reservation that keeps two parallel agents off one file silently disappears, and nothing else notices because the claim is otherwise valid. Live probe on 2026-10-02 confirmed 19 of 20 claims on the remote reserved nothing. Refuse a commit that touches anything outside .agents/tasks/ while its claim reserves no paths, naming the fix (release, re-claim with --scope). Task records stay exempt so an unscoped legacy claim can still be closed. Acceptance: nonzero hermetic tests in tests/workflow_compliance.rs for the refusal, for the task-record exemption, and for in-scope work still passing.
